alkylation_concentration.evidence: Cells were lysed with boiling guanidine-hydrochloride lysis buffer (6 M Gnd-HCl, 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.5, 5 TCEP, 10 mM CAA).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Cells were lysed with boiling guanidine-hydrochloride lysis buffer (6 M Gnd-HCl, 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.5, 5 TCEP, 10 mM CAA).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were pre-digested with endoproteinase Lys-C (Wako) for 2 h at room temperature in an enzyme/protein ratio of 1:100.
Thereafter, samples were diluted to 1 M guanidine-hydrochloride with 25 mM Tris buffer before overnight digestion with trypsin (Sigma-Aldrich) at 37 °C in an enzyme/protein ratio of 1:50.

collision_energy.evidence: Normalized collision energy was set at 27%.

ionization_type.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in positive ion mode, with spray voltage at 2 kV, heated capillary temperature at 275 °C, and funnel RF frequency at 40.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Samples were analyzed on the Evosep One system coupled to an Orbitrap Exploris 480.

ptm.evidence: Deamidation of asparagine and glutamine (NQ) was added as variable modification.
